entries.task_id: and exalt|with|praise of your lord when you arise
entries.description: And exalt with praise of your Lord when you arise
entries.subject: And exalt
entries.object: praise of your Lord when you arise

spans.text: And exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord when you arise.

entries.task_id: and|in|a part of the night exalt him and after [the setting of] the stars
entries.description: And in a part of the night exalt Him and after [the setting of] the stars
entries.subject: And
entries.object: a part of the night exalt Him and after [the setting of] the stars

spans.text: [49] AR: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ EN: And in a part of the night exalt Him and after [the setting of] the stars.

[47] AR: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ عَذَابًۭا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ EN: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a punishment before that, but most of them do not know.
[31] AR: قُلْ تَرَبَّصُوا۟ فَإِنِّى مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْمُتَرَبِّصِينَ EN: Say, "Wait, for indeed I am, with you, among the waiters."

folded.id: and exalt|with|praise of your lord when you arise
folded.subject: And exalt
folded.object: praise of your Lord when you arise

spans.text: And exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord when you arise.

folded.id: and if|they|were to see a fragment from the sky falling
folded.subject: And if
folded.object: were to see a fragment from the sky falling

spans.text: [44] AR: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ كِسْفًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطًۭا يَقُولُوا۟ سَحَابٌۭ مَّرْكُومٌۭ EN: And if they were to see a fragment from the sky falling, they would say, "[It is merely] clouds heaped up."

folded.id: and we|will|marry them to fair women with large
folded.subject: and We
folded.object: marry them to fair women with large

spans.text: [20] AR: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍۢ مَّصْفُوفَةٍۢ ۖ وَزَوَّجْنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍۢ EN: They will be reclining on thrones lined up, and We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.

[21] AR: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعَتْهُمْ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَٰنٍ أَلْحَقْنَا بِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَمَآ أَلَتْنَٰهُم مِّنْ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَىْءٍۢ ۚ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينٌۭ EN: And those who believed and whose descendants followed them in faith - We will join with them their descendants, and We will not deprive them of anything of their deeds.
[22] AR: وَأَمْدَدْنَٰهُم بِفَٰكِهَةٍۢ وَلَحْمٍۢ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ EN: And We will provide them with fruit and meat from whatever they desire.

folded.id: and|in|a part of the night exalt him and after [the setting of] the stars
folded.subject: And
folded.object: a part of the night exalt Him and after [the setting of] the stars

spans.text: [49] AR: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ EN: And in a part of the night exalt Him and after [the setting of] the stars.
[4] AR: وَٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلْمَعْمُورِ EN: And [by] the frequented House
[5] AR: وَٱلسَّقْفِ ٱلْمَرْفُوعِ EN: And [by] the heaven raised high
[10] AR: وَتَسِيرُ ٱلْجِبَالُ سَيْرًۭا EN: And the mountains will pass on, departing -
[6] AR: وَٱلْبَحْرِ ٱلْمَسْجُورِ EN: And [by] the sea filled [with fire],

folded.id: and|their|lord protected them from the punishment of hellfire
folded.subject: and
folded.object: Lord protected them from the punishment of Hellfire

spans.text: [18] AR: فَٰكِهِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ EN: Enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord protected them from the punishment of Hellfire.
[24] AR: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ غِلْمَانٌۭ لَّهُمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لُؤْلُؤٌۭ مَّكْنُونٌۭ EN: There will circulate among them [servant] boys [especially] for them, as if they were pearls well-protected.
[29] AR: فَذَكِّرْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍۢ وَلَا مَجْنُونٍ EN: So remind [O Muhammad], for you are not, by the favor of your Lord, a soothsayer or a madman.
[1] AR: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلطُّورِ EN: By the mount

folded.id: eat|and|drink in satisfaction for what you used to do
folded.subject: Eat
folded.object: drink in satisfaction for what you used to do

spans.text: [19] AR: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ EN: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."
[18] AR: فَٰكِهِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ EN: Enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord protected them from the punishment of Hellfire.

[48] AR: وَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا ۖ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ EN: And be patient, [O Muhammad], for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes.
[33] AR: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُۥ ۚ بَل لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ EN: Or do they say, "He has made it up"?
[34] AR: فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِحَدِيثٍۢ مِّثْلِهِۦٓ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَٰدِقِينَ EN: Then let them produce a statement like it, if they should be truthful.

[16] AR: ٱصْلَوْهَا فَٱصْبِرُوٓا۟ أَوْ لَا تَصْبِرُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ EN: [Enter to] burn therein; then be patient or impatient - it is all the same for you.

folded.id: is allah|above|whatever they associate with him
folded.subject: is Allah

spans.text: Exalted is Allah above whatever they associate with Him.
[13] AR: يَوْمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا EN: The Day they are thrust toward the fire of Hell with a [violent] thrust, [its angels will say],
[46] AR: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ EN: The Day their plan will not avail them at all, nor will they be helped.

folded.id: on|the|day the heaven will sway with circular motion
folded.subject: On
folded.object: Day the heaven will sway with circular motion

spans.text: [9] AR: يَوْمَ تَمُورُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ مَوْرًۭا EN: On the Day the heaven will sway with circular motion
[32] AR: أَمْ تَأْمُرُهُمْ أَحْلَٰمُهُم بِهَٰذَآ ۚ أَمْ هُمْ قَوْمٌۭ طَاغُونَ EN: Or do their minds command them to [say] this, or are they a transgressing people?
Or are they the controllers [of them]?

folded.id: or did|they|create the heavens and the earth?
folded.subject: Or did
folded.object: create the heavens and the earth?

spans.text: [36] AR: أَمْ خَلَقُوا۟ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ ۚ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ EN: Or did they create the heavens and the earth?

folded.id: or do|their|minds command them to [say] this
folded.subject: Or do

spans.text: [32] AR: أَمْ تَأْمُرُهُمْ أَحْلَٰمُهُم بِهَٰذَآ ۚ أَمْ هُمْ قَوْمٌۭ طَاغُونَ EN: Or do their minds command them to [say] this, or are they a transgressing people?
[42] AR: أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْدًۭا ۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْمَكِيدُونَ EN: Or do they intend a plan?
[33] AR: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُۥ ۚ بَل لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ EN: Or do they say, "He has made it up"?
[30] AR: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٌۭ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِۦ رَيْبَ ٱلْمَنُونِ EN: Or do they say [of you], "A poet for whom we await a misfortune of time?"
[41] AR: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ EN: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?

folded.id: or have|they|a deity other than allah?
folded.subject: Or have

spans.text: [43] AR: أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ EN: Or have they a deity other than Allah?

folded.id: or have|they|a stairway [into the heaven] upon which they listen?
folded.subject: Or have
folded.object: a stairway [into the heaven] upon which they listen?

spans.text: [38] AR: أَمْ لَهُمْ سُلَّمٌۭ يَسْتَمِعُونَ فِيهِ ۖ فَلْيَأْتِ مُسْتَمِعُهُم بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍ EN: Or have they a stairway [into the heaven] upon which they listen?

folded.id: or have|they|the depositories [containing the provision] of your lord?
folded.subject: Or have
folded.object: the depositories [containing the provision] of your Lord?

spans.text: [37] AR: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْمُصَۣيْطِرُونَ EN: Or have they the depositories [containing the provision] of your Lord?
[35] AR: أَمْ خُلِقُوا۟ مِنْ غَيْرِ شَىْءٍ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْخَٰلِقُونَ EN: Or were they created by nothing, or were they the creators [of themselves]?
[35] AR: أَمْ خُلِقُوا۟ مِنْ غَيْرِ شَىْءٍ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْخَٰلِقُونَ EN: Or were they created by nothing, or were they the creators [of themselves]?

folded.id: or|has|he daughters while you have sons?
folded.subject: Or
folded.object: He daughters while you have sons?

spans.text: [39] AR: أَمْ لَهُ ٱلْبَنَٰتُ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ EN: Or has He daughters while you have sons?

folded.id: so allah|conferred|favor upon us and protected us from the punishment of the scorching fire
folded.subject: So Allah
folded.object: favor upon us and protected us from the punishment of the Scorching Fire

spans.text: [27] AR: فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَوَقَىٰنَا عَذَابَ ٱلسَّمُومِ EN: So Allah conferred favor upon us and protected us from the punishment of the Scorching Fire.
[40] AR: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًۭا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍۢ مُّثْقَلُونَ EN: Or do you, [O Muhammad], ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?
[41] AR: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ EN: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?

folded.id: the day|their|plan will not avail them at all
folded.subject: The Day
folded.object: plan will not avail them at all

spans.text: [46] AR: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ EN: The Day their plan will not avail them at all, nor will they be helped.

folded.id: the day|they|are thrust toward the fire of hell with a [violent] thrust
folded.subject: The Day
folded.object: are thrust toward the fire of Hell with a [violent] thrust

spans.text: [13] AR: يَوْمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا EN: The Day they are thrust toward the fire of Hell with a [violent] thrust, [its angels will say],

folded.id: the righteous|will|be in gardens and pleasure
folded.subject: the righteous

spans.text: [17] AR: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَنَعِيمٍۢ EN: Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and pleasure,

folded.id: them until|they|meet their day in which they will be struck insensible -
folded.subject: them until
folded.object: meet their Day in which they will be struck insensible -

spans.text: [45] AR: فَذَرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يُصْعَقُونَ EN: So leave them until they meet their Day in which they will be struck insensible -

folded.id: then let|their|listener produce a clear authority
folded.subject: Then let

spans.text: Then let their listener produce a clear authority.

folded.id: there|will|circulate among them [servant] boys [especially] for them
folded.subject: There
folded.object: circulate among them [servant] boys [especially] for them

spans.text: [24] AR: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ غِلْمَانٌۭ لَّهُمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لُؤْلُؤٌۭ مَّكْنُونٌۭ EN: There will circulate among them [servant] boys [especially] for them, as if they were pearls well-protected.
But those who disbelieve - they are the object of a plan.

folded.id: they|will|be reclining on thrones lined up
folded.subject: They
folded.object: be reclining on thrones lined up

spans.text: [20] AR: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍۢ مَّصْفُوفَةٍۢ ۖ وَزَوَّجْنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍۢ EN: They will be reclining on thrones lined up, and We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.
[19] AR: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ EN: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."

folded.id: they|will|exchange with one another a cup [of wine] wherein [results] no ill speech or commission of sin
folded.subject: They
folded.object: exchange with one another a cup [of wine] wherein [results] no ill speech or commission of sin

spans.text: [23] AR: يَتَنَٰزَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأْسًۭا لَّا لَغْوٌۭ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأْثِيمٌۭ EN: They will exchange with one another a cup [of wine] wherein [results] no ill speech or commission of sin.
[25] AR: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ EN: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.
[26] AR: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبْلُ فِىٓ أَهْلِنَا مُشْفِقِينَ EN: They will say, "Indeed, we were previously among our people fearful [of displeasing Allah].

folded.id: this is|the|fire which you used to deny
folded.subject: This is
folded.object: Fire which you used to deny

spans.text: [14] AR: هَٰذِهِ ٱلنَّارُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ EN: "This is the Fire which you used to deny.
[11] AR: فَوَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ EN: Then woe, that Day, to the deniers,
[12] AR: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى خَوْضٍۢ يَلْعَبُونَ EN: Who are in [empty] discourse amusing themselves.

folded.id: who believed|and|whose descendants followed them in faith - we will join with them their descendants
folded.subject: who believed
folded.object: whose descendants followed them in faith - We will join with them their descendants

spans.text: [21] AR: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعَتْهُمْ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَٰنٍ أَلْحَقْنَا بِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَمَآ أَلَتْنَٰهُم مِّنْ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَىْءٍۢ ۚ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينٌۭ EN: And those who believed and whose descendants followed them in faith - We will join with them their descendants, and We will not deprive them of anything of their deeds.
Indeed, it is He who is the Beneficent, the Merciful."

[48] AR: وَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا ۖ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ EN: And be patient, [O Muhammad], for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes.
[7] AR: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَٰقِعٌۭ EN: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord will occur.
